verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs say Copilot code review feedback includes suggested changes you can apply "with a couple of clicks" (github-docs-25), and that GitHub Mobile lets you "edit files in pull requests" (github-docs-86, github-docs-98). A cloud-based development environment (Codespaces) is also offered (github-docs-3, github-docs-87). None of this explicitly documents a developer editing files and committing in a web browser in reply to reviewer comments. missing for 10: explicit docs for browser-based file editing and committing to a PR branch, applying human reviewer suggestions in the web UI, confirmation that Codespaces runs in the browser, independent or hands-on corroboration.
